# PLAN — iteration 4

## Current state assessment

The verified incumbent uses 301 LUTs and 367 FFs and is timing-feasible; iteration 4 should target the `minimize_luts` objective while preserving all gates. The current staged datapath already narrows products and partial sums, so avoid repeating those width-only changes. All eight coefficients are even, which allows an exact common factor-of-two reduction before multiplication.

## Hypothesis

Halving the coefficients and datapath values, then rounding with a 512 bias and shift by 10, should preserve every FIR result while reducing multiplier and accumulation logic width, with potential LUT and FF savings.

## Instruction for generator

In `fir16_sym_core`, replace `C0`–`C7` with their exact halves (`-3, -10, -12, 9, 55, 113, 165, 195`) and narrow the product registers and associated sum/partial registers only where their full signed ranges permit. Keep the five elastic slots and their ready/valid enables unchanged; compute the final rounded value from the halved accumulator using `(acc_half + 512) >>> 10`, preserving saturation and the existing pipeline stage. Preserve the top `// @latency 5` annotation and all reset, history, stall, and registered-output behavior.
